name: Pulsar
author: Lyle Mills
description: Windowed tone bursts move from sparse impulses to clustered formant rhythms.

controls.label: Formant
controls.description: Raises the carrier formant from the fundamental into tightly packed upper partials.

controls.label: Pulse width
controls.description: Changes each pulsar window from a short impulse to a broad burst.

controls.label: Clusters
controls.description: Increases the number of interleaved pulse clusters within each cycle.

controls.label: Skew
controls.description: Moves MAIN and AUX pulse peaks in opposite directions from early pluck to late swell.

outputs.main: Primary pulse train; the stereo toggle does not change this fixed MAIN/AUX pair.
outputs.aux: Complementary phase-offset train; the stereo toggle does not change this fixed MAIN/AUX pair.
